quill_new_thermal.text: Conn, Sensors. New thermal return, bearing two-eight-zero.

abara_range.text: Conn, Fire control. Bearing only on Sierra Two. I need a leg to range her.

castellan_hot.text: Conn, Engineering. Burn will run hot. Recommend a shorter one.

dace_vent.text: Conn, Thermal. Sink at eighty percent. Forced vent in twenty seconds.

abara_vampire.text: Vampire, vampire. Bearing two-one-zero, impact in forty-five.

pell_offer.text: Captain, I can run the sensors for you. It would be faster. It would also be seen.

fenwick_breach.text: Skipper, breach in aft stores and a fire. Which first, the sink or the drive?
